basic_info.description: Prime Location 6 unit boutique building, nestled in a Mediterranean building minutes from Marina Green and Crissy Field. Two blocks from vibrant restaurants, boutiques, and shopping, this gem offers both convenience and style.  High ceilings have elegant crown molding. The remodeled kitchen features a Wolf Range with induction cooktop, built-in Whirlpool microwave, Bosch fridge and dishwasher, custom cabinets by Olde World Mill & Cabinets, and stunning quartz counters with subway tile.  The spacious bedroom accommodates a king-size bed, dresser, and chairs, and has a walk-in closet.   The large art deco bathroom features a soaking tub, separate walk-in shower, Toto toilet, and a modern vanity and lighting.   Entertain in the formal dining room, complemented by original art deco built-ins, or unwind in the expansive living room with a cozy bar alcove.  There is a verdant green outlook through new double-pane windows adorned with stylish plantation shutters.   Beautifully refinished hardwood floors flow throughout the space, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The unit also features a separate office alcove with built-in desk and cabinets ideal for remote work or study.  Over 1,000 sq. ft. of living space, garage parking, a roof deck and garden.
